items.name: Origin cape
items.blurb: taupe wool, a weighted hem, a glint running down one silver thread. Every account has one.

items.name: Bespoke cape
items.blurb: wool in the colour you choose, an ivory yoke piped in silver, a pearl at the clasp.

items.name: Meridian cape
items.blurb: ivory and taupe meeting at a brass seam, a jade at its head, cut to a swallowtail.

items.name: Atelier cape
items.blurb: an ivory V-yoke piped in silver, an amethyst where it closes, a bias-cut hem.

items.name: Nocturne cape
items.blurb: a constellation stitched in silver; light runs along the thread to one ice-topaz star.

items.name: Regent cape
items.blurb: charcoal wool framed in gold, a gold crest set with a garnet, cut to a point.

items.name: Blade wings
items.blurb: ivory lacquer blades on a polished silver spar, an amethyst at each wrist.

items.name: Halcyon ring
items.blurb: a silver ring that floats behind you, an ice-topaz held at its heart.

items.name: Vesper sheath
items.blurb: a sword in a lacquered scabbard across the back, gold fittings, a garnet pommel.

items.name: Atelier fedora
items.blurb: bone felt, a pinched crown, the brim snapped down; an amethyst on the band.

items.name: Sovereign crown
items.blurb: worked gold on an ermine band, eight points, one garnet at the front.

items.name: Cloister hood
items.blurb: a bone wool hood with a peaked cowl, edged in brass, a jade at the throat.

items.name: Aureole
items.blurb: a fine band of polished gold with a single pearl at the front.

items.name: Lumen
items.blurb: a silver ring of rays, an amethyst at its crown.

items.name: Porcelain mask
items.blurb: ivory porcelain, a brass hairline, one jade tear.

items.name: Aegis visor
items.blurb: brushed steel across the eyes, a slit of ice-topaz glass.

items.name: Greeting
items.blurb: a raised hand, two easy waves, chin up.

items.name: Applause
items.blurb: three unhurried claps for a good fight.

items.name: Reverence
items.blurb: a slow court bow, one hand to the heart.

items.name: Salute
items.blurb: a crisp salute, held, to the other side.

items.name: Nonchalance
items.blurb: a shrug with the palms open, unbothered.

items.name: Repose
items.blurb: sit down wherever you stand, at ease, until you move.

items.name: Gilt sparks
items.blurb: fine sparks of gold kicked up at your heels.

items.name: Amethyst dust
items.blurb: cut amethyst motes that drift up behind you.

items.name: Topaz frost
items.blurb: ice-topaz facets that settle where you stepped.

items.name: Jade steps
items.blurb: small jade tiles that climb in step with your stride.

items.name: Founder
items.blurb: a gold pin set with a garnet, for the players who were here first. Not for sale.

items.name: VOID player
items.blurb: the VOID ring as a silver pin. Every account has one.

items.name: Atelier pin
items.blurb: amethyst enamel in a polished silver rim.

items.name: Laurel pin
items.blurb: a brass laurel round a jade.
